# Real Estate With Shirin

> Shirin Abplanalp is a licensed North Idaho REALTOR® with Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Jacklin Real Estate, specializing in relocation buyers and seniors (SRES®) across Post Falls, Coeur d'Alene, Hayden, Rathdrum, and Sandpoint. 11 years of experience, 100+ transactions closed.

## Key Pages
- [About Shirin](https://www.realestatewithshirin.com/about): Background, credentials, and her relocation from Bend, Oregon to North Idaho
- [Buyers](https://www.realestatewithshirin.com/buyers): Buyer representation and relocation services
- [Sellers](https://www.realestatewithshirin.com/sellers): Seller representation and market pricing
- [Articles](https://www.realestatewithshirin.com/articles): Local research guides on North Idaho relocation, city comparisons, cost of living, schools, commutes, and market timing
- [Contact](https://www.realestatewithshirin.com/contact): Get in touch

## About
Licensed Idaho REALTOR® (License #1371861), SRES® (Seniors Real Estate Specialist), member of the National Association of REALTORS® and the Coeur d'Alene Association of REALTORS®. Serving Kootenai, Bonner, and Shoshone counties.
